                        STAFF’S ADVICE NOTICE NO. 341 MEMO
        The Utility Division Staff (“Staff”) of the New Mexico Public Regulation Commission

 (“NMPRC” or the “Commission”) hereby submits Staff’s Advice Notice No. 341 Memo and

 would direct the Commission’s attention to the Advice Notice Memo of Elisha Leyba-Tercero,

 attached, stating that Advice Notice No. 341 was disapproved by the November 19, 2026

 Commission issued Final Order Partially Adopting Certification of Stipulation.

 Dated this 20th Day of November 2026.




                                             Respectfully submitted,


                                             /s/ Judith Amer
                                             Judith Amer
                                             Attorney, Legal Division
                                             New Mexico Public Regulation Commission
                                             P.O. Box 1269 | Santa Fe, NM 87504-1269
                                             Email – Judith.Amer@prc.nm.gov
                          ADVICE NOTICE MEMORANDUM

                                                                             November 20, 2026

                                                                       Docket No. 25-00079-UT

Docket Caption:       In the Matter of Southwestern Public Service Company’s Application for:
                      (1) Revision of Its Retail Rates Under Advice Notice 341; and (2) Other
                      Associated Relief



Recommendation:       Southwestern Public Service Company’s Advice Notice No. 341 has been
                      disapproved pursuant to the Commission’s Final Order Partially Adopting
                      Certification of Stipulation in Case No. 25-00079-UT.



Overview

       On November 20, 2025, Southwestern Public Service Company (“SPS” or the “Company”)

filed Docket No. 25-00079-UT, In the Matter of Southwestern Public Service Company’s

Application for: (1) Revision of Its Retail Rates Under Advice Notice No. 341; and (2) other

Associated Relief. The Company filed the associated Advice Notice No. 341 with a proposed

effective date of December 20, 2025. However, on December 11, 2025, the Commission issued its

Order Suspending Advice Notice No. 341 for a period of nine months. The suspension period was

later extended to November 30, 2026, upon a joint motion to extend the suspension period to ensure

compliance with the Commission’s Future Test Year Rule and SPS’s agreement to extend to

November 30, 2026. As set forth below, the Commission has disapproved SPS’s Advice Notice

No. 341.

Analysis

       On June 22, 2026, a contested Comprehensive Stipulation (“Stipulation”) was filed in

Docket No. 25-00079-UT. On October 23, 2026, the Hearing Examiners presiding over that case



                                                1
 issued their Certification of Stipulation recommending that the Stipulation be approved with

modifications. On November 19, 2026, the Commission issued its Final Order Partially Adopting

Certification of Stipulation (“Final Order”). The Final Order, among other things, disapproved

SPS’s Advice Notice No. 341. Specifically, Findings and Conclusions Paragraph 101 provides

that:

        The tariffs filed under Advice Notice No. 341 should not be approved.

As it relates to Advice Notice No. 341, Footnote 171 of the Final Order directs Staff as follows:

        Due to the recent changes in the internal processing in advice notices, Staff is
        advised to file the advice notice memo in response to now invalidated AN 341
        within this docket.


Conclusion

        In accordance with the Final Order in Docket No. 25-00079-UT, Staff files this memo

providing for disapproval of SPS Advice Notice No. 341 as set forth in the attached Advice Notice

Memorandum Processing Worksheet. Advice Notice No. 341 should be disapproved as of the date

of issuance of the Commission’s Final Order in Docket No. 25-00079-UT, November 19, 2026.



                                                     Respectfully submitted,

                                                     /s/ Elisha Leyba-Tercero
                                                     Elisha Leyba-Tercero, Utility Division
                                                     New Mexico Public Regulation Commission
